description: Find every place that references a given Canton Improvement Proposal (CIP): forum threads, mailing-list posts, blog articles, Dev Fund grant proposals, and sibling CIPs that require/cite it. A reverse-reference (backlink) lookup: use for 'who is discussing CIP-X and where' / impact questions. Returns aggregated per-source counts, not individual items. For individual forum posts/mailing messages and CCPEDIA's finer per-message mailing-list granularity, use get_cip_citations instead. Not for the proposal's own text (get_cip) or its vote records (get_cip_votes). Canton ecosystem only. Not Cardano or other 'CIP' schemes.
name: get_cip_mentions
